chain.text:
**Facility**
60-cm reflector (2017); 20-cm refractor for outreach.
195 useful nights/year average; 168 in 2024 (wet autumn).

**Data**
~400 GB/month; nightly 40-min transfer to Marseille university server.
Raw frames never deleted; compressed after two years.

**Instrument**
Camera replaced March 2025; 30% lower read noise.
Firmware update pending; needs one full offline night.

**Incidents**
2023: dome motor seized, telescope hit dome wall, counterweight rod bent; rod replaced, limit switch added.
Feb 2025: 1.2-s timestamp offset lost three weeks of photometry; GPS check now every session.

**Rules**
No runs during public outreach evenings.
Acquisition software changes need a test night.

**Open item**
Spanish simultaneous-observation collaboration: shared scheduling tool unevaluated; network capacity for simultaneous transfers unknown.
